en: ...And that's all I have for you today.
I hope you enjoyed the story.
*sigh*
Now you'll know not to panic if you run into any other witches.
What are you doing in there, Canele?
Come on, everyone's waiting for you at the tea party.
I was just sharing tales of old times.
I see.
But don't share too much.
Leave some for the stars to whisper.
All right.
Looks like I have places to be.
I'll leave this book here for you instead.
Well, until next time...!
Oh, what's this?
This page doesn't belong in here.
Well, whatever.
...And so, the witches lived happily ever after.
...is something I hope you weren't naive enough to actually believe.
This isn't a fairy tale after all.
Truth be told, their same old mundane lives just kept on going.
If you're interested, I can tell you as much as you'd like.
Ughhhh...
I don't want to do the tea party.
I said this last time, Nahatra. Don't...
..."Don't become a pessimistic witch?"
Exactly! The garden is your realm.
And it's much more colorful than it used to be!
If you want, you can even have the largest tea party any witch has ever seen.
But... what's the point?
No matter how colorful the garden becomes, dreams are just dreams... not reality.
If I just...
If I just close my eyes...
My existence... Everything... It all...
Eek! Nahatra!
A nightmare! A nightmare is flowing out!
Sorry, I must have lost myself for a moment.
Did I try to destroy the garden again?
It seemed a little like that.
Don't worry!
By the next tea party, you'll have lightened up again, right?
Right. The next tea party...
But until then, what can I do to ease this feeling of emptiness?
Maybe if I erase half of the realms, my head might clear up a bit?
As long as you spare our club!
Understood. In that case...
Wait! Wait!
Not so fast!
Remember what happened last time we erased some realms?
It wasn't any use!
...Yes, it just made things emptier.
Haah... I guess I need some more rest.
Are you sure you're okay?
Yes. Thank you for worrying about me.
How's Nahatra?
Worse than before, I think.
She seems to be losing control of herself.
Did you find out anything?
It's exactly as I guessed.
Witches who came here on their own spread their realms here and there.
The garden has become so large that it took a while to even notice the presence of those other witches.
I guess our garden has become quite famous.
Hmph... I wanted to keep it as my own small, precious secret!
All these new realms seem to have exceeded the number Nahatra can handle.
Nahatra and the garden are practically one being.
Clashes between realms, frequent changes, irregular tectonic shifts...
All of these things are having a negative effect on Nahatra.
So what do we do about it?
We should inform the other witches, tidy up the realms, and get them to participate in the tea party.
Not to sound like a broken record, but the tea party is an important ritual that gives Nahatra strength.
We must help Nahatra better perceive the realms of the other witches so that we can continue sustaining the garden.
Hmm... But will the witches listen to us?
We'll simply have to expel them if necessary.
However, it would be more reasonable to have them participate in the tea party rather than disrupt the balance between the realms.
So hurry up and fetch every single witch in the garden.
I-I don't really like going on business trips...
But Rims! This could be an opportunity!
We can promote our club to the new witches!
Imagine what this could to for our profits!
Oh, Berry. You really are a genius saleswitch!
I know! So let's go and get a head start!
Do they even possess a sense of danger?
You go to the swamp, Sil. I'll give you the directions.
The swamp?
The little spiders told me that there were witches there. Go find out if it's true.
I'm going to be busy for a while...
Don't tell me...
Are these all newly arrived witches?!
What if I told you...
As far as I know, not even a quarter of the new witches are gathered here.
What?! Just how many are there?!
We are currently in the process of negotiations between witches
Mostly concerning the boundaries between realms...
Ugh, my head.
Big house. Lots of witches. Never seen this before.
Aha, is this the swamp witch...?
Maydel, this is Chloe.
Maydel is pleased to meet you.
Come here.
I would love to have a proper conversation with you...
But as you can see, we don't have the leisure of that right now.
Wait there. I'll bring you a cup of tea.
I'd love to talk with you about your realm when we have time.
Okay.
How is Nahatra faring?
Much better.
Gathering the witches and tidying up their realms was effective, as we'd hoped.
You can go talk to her in her room, if you'd like.
Oh, Sil. Come on in.
Have you met the witches outside?
Not yet.
But I can sense the kinds of beings they are without meeting face-to-face.
Extremely vividly.
It seems like things are going to get even more chaotic than before.
It's a good thing.
As long as you think so. That's all that matters.
Are you feeling better physically?
It feels like the fog in my head has cleared.
Thank you. It's all thanks to you girls.
Don't mention it....
Do you still feel that way? As if...
As if existing within a dream is without meaning?
Yes.
...I do.
That's why I wanted to invite more witches to the garden.
It was a kind of... hunger. Or instinct.
But there's one question that won't leave my mind.
Can this void ever be filled?
Am I nothing more than a mirage born in the subconscious of living beings?
Or...
Nahatra! Stop thinking so deeply...!
I'm fine. There's no need to act so surprised.
So that's why Rims & Berry are always teasing the other witches.
It's very fun.
Don't worry. The disharmony in the garden has settled.
More importantly, there's something we desperately need.
Oh? What's that?
A bigger tea party table.
Embrace me.
Excuse me? Is somebody there?
Embrace me, witch.
Whoa?! What the...
I... am a seed...
I am... potential...
A witch named Maydel created me.
She did mention something about her beautiful work being lost...
Wanna come with me? Maydel's been looking for you.
I shall... become more...
Uh-oh, it's been contaminated by nightmares.
That must be what Maydel meant by "sullied."
Sorry, but I don't wanna get mixed up with any seed who's been influenced by nightmare.
You will regret... this...
How...
How did you avoid... becoming a part of the swamp?
Maydel is protecting me.
Anyway, you'd better be prepared.
I'm going to deal with you here and take Maydel to the tea party....
Embrace... me...
I don't want any power contaminated by nightmares.
Contaminated...
No... It is a blessing...
You escaped me... once...
But not... again...
You seem real obsessed with ruling this swamp.
The more trouble you cause, the more this swamp falls into disarray.
What's the point in ruling a swamp like that?
The swamp is... merely my first target...
In time... the entire garden... will be one with me...
You... are back...
Yes. I am.
This witch... does not die easily...
...I hate you...!
I hate... witches...
Begone... from my swamp.
Sorry, but you're the only one who needs to leave this swamp.
You didn't choose to be contaminated by nightmares...
But there's nothing else I can do about it.
I now know...
Witches are... hateful beings...
Every last one of them... must be exterminated...
Oh wow, that's creepy.
Now I have one more reason to get rid of you.
I will no longer... speak with witches...
I'm back, you ugly monster.
Where are you?
It really meant it about not speaking with witches, huh?
Embrace me.
What do you mean by that, exactly?
New... life... New power...
Aha...
Embrace me!
I'm sorry, but I'll have to refuse.
Embrace me!!
You will not... escape... this time...
I will absorb you... and grow even stronger...
Ah... I can smell you...
My prey...
Still... not enough...
I remain... unsatisfied...
The swamp... is calling you...
We shall... become one...
Seeds... must grow...
You will be... my nutrients...!
Ah, little seed of Maydel.
...Maydel didn't do her best.
...Are you okay?
...Maydel is sad.
Maydel's work of art.
The pure seed was contaminated.
It seems to have been influenced by the nightmare....
Maydel understands nightmares now.
Nightmares contaminate the swamp.
If witches like you don't participate in the tea party, this will happen more and more often.
That's why I came here to fetch you.
Sil did her best for the swamp.
On behalf of all the creatures of the swamp, Maydel expresses her gratitude.
Okay. Maydel will participate in the tea party.
Great! I look forward to seeing you there.
I'll explain it all in more detail in time.
Oh! And...
Please don't be too shocked if the other witches act a little strange.
Ugh...
The air is so much heavier and more humid here.
Oh! That saves me the trouble of looking for you.
Hello there. My name is Sil.
I'm one of the witches who came to live in the garden before you....
This is Maydel's realm.
Maydel has not been here long.
And Maydel is...?
I am Maydel.
Oh, umm, I see.
Do you always refer to yourself in third person?
Maydel communicates through mud, rotting leaves, wet moss, and roots.
That’s what feels most familiar.
Communication through sound and gestures is difficult to understand.
But Maydel is doing her best.
Don’t worry, I get what you mean.
Phew, finally someone I can speak with.
Ah! But actually, I didn't come here just to say hello.
Maydel is listening.
Do you know anything about the tea party?
No.
As expected.
Okay, how should I explain this...
Umm...
If you don't participate in the tea party, your realm will disappear!
...Do you understand?
Yes.
Good.
So, you'll join, right?
Maydel will not.
Why!?
Maydel's beautiful work was sullied.
Something here is responsible.
Maydel is...
Maydel is sad.
Your work? And what's that?
Maydel made it. An old seed.
It's hard to explain...
Did you lose something important to you?
Is that why you can't move right now?
Can you tell me more about it?
Maydel... Maydel...
The swamp...
That...
Maydel is doing her best.
Okay, fine.
I'll go and see what happened myself.
Will that be okay?
Maydel is grateful.
Ugh, my head...
Did I just experience death?
But it felt strangely different from usual.
My body sank down and down into heavy water...
Then suddenly, I woke up by the river.
Dying in the swamp means becoming part of the swamp.
But Maydel watches over you so that the nightmares here cannot reach you.
Even in the cycle of birth and decay, you will not be touched by them.
Ah, so that's what happened.
But if you've been watching, you'll have seen that fighting alone isn't easy.
How about fighting alongside me this time...?
Maydel has never won a fight against anything.
Maydel always chooses harmony over conflict...
But while watching you fight, Maydel thought of a way to help you.
The creatures of the swamp possess contaminated seeds.
Bring those seeds to Maydel.
Seeds? How will that help?
Maydel can purify the contaminated seeds.
With the seed's power, Maydel can breathe new life into them.
It will help you in battle.
Well, if you say so.
Urgh! Yuck! Blergh!
I think I swallowed some mud.
Finally.
Maydel was waiting.
For the cycle of death to find you...
What? You were waiting for me to die?
That's kind of messed up.
That is not what Maydel meant.
Maydel... Maydel...
Maydel is...
...doing her best...
I was just teasing! A joke!
You’ve got no sense of humor.
Joke... Maydel does not know that concept very well.
I hear it is a way for humans to display their intimacy with each other.
Don't overthink it.
Then... Are Sil and Maydel friends?
Huh?
Well, we've barely just met, so it's still a little awkward.
I mean, I don't even know what your face looks like. Haha!
Maydel understands.
Okay! Yes! We're friends! Let's say we're friends!
But why were you waiting for me?
Maydel thought of a way to make your weapon stronger.
Maydel gathered Maydel's swamp essence and forged a new weapon.
Maydel hopes this will be of help to you.
You made a weapon for me?
Thank you, I'll make good use of it.
It's a little strange.
Normally, there's pain when you die.
But dying in this swamp is different.
Like... being covered by a very heavy, thick cotton blanket.
Through repeated deaths, you and a part of the swamp have become intertwined.
You're right. I can feel that the boundary between me and the swamp has become blurred.
This isn't going to cause any problems, is it?
It is Maydel's job to ensure no problems occur.
And if any problem arises, it will be only minor.
Such as luminescent mushrooms growing on your head.
...Okay, we need to resolve this as soon as possible.
Urgh...
I'd have asked Abigail or Fiena for help if I knew it would be this difficult.
...Actually, that would have just complicated things further.
Maydel is curious.
Are those names you just mentioned other witches?
Yes.
This swamp will really come alive if they show up here.
But it could be a good opportunity to make new friends...
Should I invite them over sometime?
Maydel... will pass.
Ugh, that one was a mistake.
I won't let you get away with it next time.
I'm back.
Are you okay, Sil?
I'm fine.
I haven't lost yet!
I'm just... taking a little rest.
Phew, I thought I was a real goner that time.
Ugh... I hate swamps!
I... I didn't mean that!
This isn't over.
Was I too reckless?
No! There's nothing wrong with being brave.
I'll just have to try something new.
Yuck, my whole body is covered in mud.
It makes you look natural.
I don't think I want to look natural.
I think I swallowed a bug when I was reborn.
The exact number of bugs was...
You don't have to tell me!
Can you take off that mask?
Maydel refuses.
What if that's what it takes to help you?
Maydel... wants to refuse...
But... if you insist...
F-Forget it! I was just asking!
I didn't realize it was such a sensitive topic.
All moss and roots are imbued with power.
Calm your breathing and walk through the mist.
Then, you will feel the magic contained in each leaf.
Grow through harmony.
Prosperity and decay are fruits grown from the same branch.
In the name of all witchkind.
Maydel, I just felt something... change inside me.
What is it?
There is no need to worry.
This power will awaken new abilities within you.
I can feel magic flowing through my hands.
I think I can fight better now.
I am glad you find it helpful.
Sil...
Now that the power of the swamp has seeped into your body, it is fully yours.
You will be able to use it freely.
...Strange.
This ability... feels as natural as if I've been using it for ages.
Maydel worked hard to ensure this new power harmonized within you.
Maydel hopes it will be of help to you in the future.
